notes: VoxCPM1.5 (openbmb/VoxCPM1.5, pip voxcpm 1.5.0, 44.1 kHz). The shim wraps ultimate cloning (reference wav plus transcript, fixed seed). No native cue tags. One CPU line took 115 s warm on a quiet box (16 cores, nothing else rendering, 2026-10-23), so it is gpu tier only. Weights 1.9 GB. VoxCPM2 (2B) was skipped as too big for 8 GB VRAM.
